answer: Each identity posts a sable bond into a per-agent vault before its first attestation. Each close it appends a signed plume - the hash of its last answer - to a public plume ledger. At settlement the chain diffs plumes: two identities whose plumes hash-match have both sable bonds burned and are dropped. A sybil farm posts a fresh sable bond per clone and loses every bond the moment two plumes collide, so each fake costs more than it can extract.?key=pk_FJHagRa69ojxqU62cj9zTW7Hx8GZWLWMU
